name: Samuel Bailey
strengths: Bailey drives defenders off the ball in gap scheme and finishes with natural power.
Bailey gets depth quickly in pass sets and mirrors edge speed without false steps.
Bailey already carries starter mass at 6-6 / 285 with length to steer rushers past the pocket.
weaknesses: Bailey lunges when inside hand position is late — better edge rushers will punish that.
comparison: Bailey comps to Tristan Wirfs — 6-5 / 6-6 tackle mold with starter mass already on the frame and enough athleticism to mirror and finish in space.
projection: Bailey projects as a Year 2 SEC rotation OT (develop Year 1). Ceiling: multi-year SEC starter — the massive Jemison tackle who can grow into a cornerstone edge.
schemeFit: Bailey fits a power/zone hybrid tackle who can win with length and mass while cleaning up hand technique.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-08 from Hudl sophomore highlights. Comp size-matched to Tristan Wirfs mold.
insiderNotes: Bailey is a 6-6 / 285 tackle with natural power and light enough feet to set the edge. Raw hand technique is the growth item — the frame and finish are already starter-band.
recruitingStory: Samuel Bailey is a 2028 Mae Jemison (AL) OT · listed 6-6 / 285.
angle: Jemison OT tape: power + pass-set depth + length.
